facts.text: Dictionaries define soup as a liquid food, and a bowl of cereal with milk is unambiguously a liquid food served in a bowl.
Cold soups like gazpacho prove that soup does not need to be hot, removing the temperature objection entirely.
Cereal preparation mirrors soup preparation: a base liquid, solid ingredients added, served in a bowl, eaten with a spoon.
Soup is cooked, or at least assembled with culinary intent, while cereal is poured from a box in thirty seconds with no transformation of ingredients.
Nobody in the history of restaurants has ordered soup and been served Cheerios, which tells you everything about how language actually works.
Milk is a beverage ingredient, not a broth, and calling milk a broth stretches the culinary vocabulary beyond recognition.
Breakfast soups do exist in some cuisines, so the categories are closer than purists admit.
Food taxonomy is descriptive, not prescriptive, so the debate reveals more about how people categorize than about the food itself.

cereal-soup.motion: This house believes cereal is a soup.

facts.text: A hot dog consists of a filling enclosed by bread on multiple sides, which matches the structural definition of a sandwich used by several dictionaries.
The USDA classifies a hot dog in its sandwich-adjacent categories for nutritional labeling purposes.
Submarine sandwiches also use a single hinged roll, and nobody disputes that a meatball sub is a sandwich.
The National Hot Dog and Sausage Council officially declared in 2015 that a hot dog is not a sandwich, speaking for the industry itself.
Hot dogs have their own distinct culinary category, cultural rituals, and even their own council, which sandwiches do not need.
If a hot dog is a sandwich, then by the same logic a taco in a hard shell and a loaf of bread sliced lengthwise would be sandwiches too, which stretches the word past usefulness.
Merriam-Webster defines a sandwich as two or more slices of bread with filling between them, a definition the hinged hot dog bun awkwardly straddles.
The cube rule of food identification places the hot dog in its own category, separate from sandwiches.

hot-dog-sandwich.motion: This house believes a hot dog is a sandwich.

facts.text: Hawaiian pizza was invented in 1962 by Sam Panopoulos in Chatham, Ontario, and it has survived on menus worldwide for over sixty years.
The sweet-savory contrast is a cornerstone of cooking, from honey-glazed ham to salted caramel, and pineapple with salty ham follows the same proven principle.
Pineapple is rich in vitamin C and bromelain, so it is one of the few pizza toppings that adds genuine nutritional value.
Topping polls consistently rank pineapple among the most divisive toppings in existence, which suggests it clashes with what most people expect pizza to be.
Pineapple's high water content and acidity can make the crust soggy and overwhelm the delicate flavors of cheese and tomato.
Traditional Neapolitan pizza is protected by strict culinary standards that would never admit tropical fruit, and six decades of debate have not settled the matter.
Celebrity chefs are split on the question, which proves reasonable experts can disagree about taste.
Pineapple on pizza is a topping choice, not a moral failing, and food preferences vary enormously across cultures.

pineapple-pizza.motion: This house believes pineapple belongs on pizza.

facts.text: A tab is a single character, so tab-indented files are smaller and faster to navigate with arrow keys than space-indented ones.
Tabs let every developer choose their own visual indent width, which is a genuine accessibility win for people with visual impairments.
Go's official formatter, gofmt, enforces tabs, and Go is one of the most widely used languages in industry.
Python's PEP 8 style guide recommends spaces, and Python is the most taught programming language in the world.
Mixed tabs and spaces cause invisible, maddening bugs, and spaces render identically in every editor, terminal, and diff tool ever made.
Large developer surveys have repeatedly shown spaces winning majority preference among professional programmers.
Modern formatters like Prettier and Black settle the debate automatically, so the argument matters less every year.
The tabs-versus-spaces debate has raged since the 1980s without resolution, suggesting both options are workable.

tabs-vs-spaces.motion: This house believes tabs are superior to spaces for indentation.
